card.name: Link words before political or official titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, of, to, against and following in historical or political prose, right where a title or official body (a general, government, ambassador) may come next.

modes.label: Preposition after event noun
modes.description: A word like by, of or against after an event such as an assassination, coup or takeover, before the actor or target.
modes.example: THE ASSASSINATION of Franz Ferdinand, heir to the Austro- Hungarian throne,<< by>> a Serbian nationalist in Sarajevo,

modes.label: Preposition before authorities
modes.description: To or of before government or official bodies in local-history accounts of settlements.
modes.example: to submit the case of the settlers<< to>> the government authorities there, and learn definitely

card.writes: It raises the chance of rank and office titles such as Lieutenant, General, Ambassador, Captain and Vice coming next.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in history texts when a rank or official title is likely to follow.
